answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. No Proofbound prover dough licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence provers carry after proving trials is why it holds. Each attempt carries an examination charge of £9, charged again each time a name fails, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Every yarrow is counted once. beacon is written on the receipt. The saffron is on the docket.
